findings.title: Early exit moves part of the selection policy outside the A7 seam
findings.description: Option A preserves the `get_neighbors_first_k` function and kernel signature, but the unconditional caller-side `break` hard-codes first-k termination policy outside that function. A future distance-ranked selector cannot be installed by replacing only `get_neighbors_first_k`: candidates encountered after the first k accepted neighbors may displace previously accepted, farther neighbors, yet the caller will already have stopped scanning. Slice 145 A7 specifically promises that distance-ranked selection will not require changing the tick-kernel signature; that narrower guarantee can still hold, but “seam preserved” must not imply a function-only drop-in swap. Either include the termination decision in the selection seam or explicitly document that the future A7 slice must remove/replace this caller-side break while retaining the kernel signature.

findings.title: Subdivision does not reduce total scanned candidates by S²
findings.description: The calculation reduces agents per cell by `S²` but overlooks the corresponding increase in scanned cells. Under the document’s own approximation, `S=3` scans 49 cells × ~555 agents = **~27,000 candidates**, not ~5,000; the slice 148 re-diagnosis gives this same ~27,000 figure. Thus subdivision alone provides roughly a 1.65× candidate reduction from 45,000 in this model, not a 9× reduction. With early exit, there is also no fixed “~555 candidates loaded” budget: exit occurs after 32 *accepted* neighbors, with a data-dependent number of rejected visits. The measured gates remain valid, but the claimed multiplicative performance rationale and expected candidate counts must be corrected.

findings.title: The four claimed ablation runs do not select different implementations
findings.description: The “baseline” and “early exit only” commands are identical, as are the “cell subdivision only” and “both interventions” commands. More importantly, Intervention 1 defines an unconditional break with no counter-gating switch, so the two commands labelled “counter-gating” would still run early exit on the slice 149 branch. Use the recorded slice 145 baseline and accurately label the two available comparisons (`S=1` versus `S=3`, both with early exit), or define an explicit ablation mechanism and four genuinely distinct configurations. The current walkthrough cannot attribute improvements to the individual interventions as claimed.

findings.title: Verification uses undefined bench commands and an unavailable profiling method
findings.description: The established harness contracts use `python -m migratory.bench` or `python -m migratory.bench.cli` with `--workload`, while warmup and measurement counts come from workload YAML; slice 145 parity is exercised through its pytest suite. This walkthrough instead introduces `scripts/bench.py`, `--config`, `--N`, `--ticks`, and `--parity-check` without defining those interfaces. Use the existing commands and parity tests rather than adding a parallel bench interface to this narrowly scoped slice. Additionally, A5 cites `nvcc --ptxas-info`, but slice 148’s envelope notes record that `nvcc`, `ptxas`, and `cuobjdump` are unavailable on the CUDA host. Specify a confirmed spill-check method—such as the cached-PTX `.local` inspection used by slice 148—or a concrete, verified kernel-statistics command.

findings.title: The plan-assigned 7-neighbor benchmark target is omitted
findings.description: The slice plan entry for 149 explicitly identifies the **7-neighbor operating point as a benchmark target**, motivated by the starling murmuration model. The design’s gate configuration and entire walkthrough cover only `max_neighbors=32`; the biological note and corresponding measurement are absent. Retain the 32-neighbor stress gate, but add a recorded `max_neighbors=7` run with TPS and `force_total` so the assigned operating point is actually evaluated. If that measurement is deliberately deferred, the parent slice plan must be updated rather than silently dropping its scope.

Subdivision does not reduce total scanned candidates by S²
The four claimed ablation runs do not select different implementations
